newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq shares ease slightly on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq shares ease slightly on profit-taking.

text.p: Nasdaq shares eased slightly in a mixed session as investors took profits after three consecutive sessions in which over-the-counter shares posted ever increasing record closing levels, traders said.
The Nasdaq composite index shed 7.07 points or 0.50 percent to close unofficially at 1403.11. Gaining issues, however, outpaced losing issues 2168 to 2018 on total volume of 624 million shares.
Personal computer makers lost ground after Salomon Brothers downgraded International Business Machines Corp to buy from strong buy, traders said.

"The techs have had quite a run lately, so some profit-taking is not surprising. The cut in IBM also kind of set the tone for the PC companies and the rest of the techs. It was a kind of an excuse to bank some profits," one trader said.

Dell Computer Corp lost 5-1/4 to 110-3/8. Networking stocks such as 3Com Corp and U.S. Robotics Corp also eased after three sessions of stunning gains. Boston Chicken Inc dropped 1-3/8 to 16-3/4 on news that its second quarter sales have been flat to slightly negative. It earlier said it wasn't happy with store sales.
